text: Sofya City
Filecia
Pelulu
Libarza
Adonius
Lefina
[ff6464]White Day Event has ended.[ffffff]
Oh, Pelulu...
There you are!!
There's no need to react like you've just seen a\nghost...
If you were a ghost, at least I'd know what to do!\nI could run away or just pass out!\nBut what am I supposed to do now?
If you say that, you're putting me in a tough\nspot...\nAnyway, I need your help.
You want us to collect ingredients for sweets\nagain, right? First, tell us what you're up to!\nThen we'll decide whether to help you or not~.
...Well, actually this time...\nDo you remember the sweets Lefina and I made last\ntime?
How could I forget that?!\nSo, what is it this time?\nPlanning to create another living creature?
Yes...I guess I wasn't able to control it properly\nlast time, so I made some adjustments...\nTheoretically, it should be fine this time...
Since I'd like to test it out, I'd like you to\ncollect some ingredients for me...
Why can't you just make normal sweets?!\nWhy do you always have to create monsters and\ncontrol them?!
Since you've put us through this a few times,\nwe're kinda used to it now, though~. You're gonna\nmake us help you with the test too, right?
If it goes out of control again, Lefina and I will\nfind a way to take care of it...
What? Lefina is coming too?
It was something Lefina and I made together...\nSo I plan to have her join me when I make it\nlater.
You sure it's okay?
No way, that's definitely not okay.
But, are you really sure it's gonna be okay?\nBased on her track record and our experience...
I'd say maybe, perhaps, definitely, for sure...\nIt's not gonna be okay...
No, no, no, that's definitely not gonna be okay!!\nThat girl is gonna screw things up for sure!!
Well, you're probably right...\nI guess that's inevitable...
Then don't do it!!
Don't tell anyone I said this, but actually,\nI kinda expect that to happen...I intend to use\nthe situation as a battle drill for me and Lefina.
A battle drill?
Yes, if it's gonna happen anyway, I figure\nI should just assume it's gonna go out of control\nand try to make the most of it...
I'm not sure about that...I feel like everything\nis going in the wrong direction. But, whatever,\nas long as I get my reward, I don't care.
Next time, please just make normal sweets!
Thank you...\nAlright then, please gather the ingredients listed\nhere...
What exactly are those guys up to...?
Don't you think it's better to stay out of it,\nMaster Libarza? I'm just telling you because you\nasked me to notify you if those two made a move.
Hmph!\nYou actually think I can't do what those little\nbrats can do?
It's not about that...\nWell, I've done my part, so can I stop here?
What a coward!\nYoungsters these days are useless!
I see you've got all the ingredients. Good job...
Finally, everything's ready!\nNow, it's time to show what I'm truly capable of!
Yes...\nAll right, let's head out of town first...
Wh-why do we have to leave the town?!\nYou think I'll screw up again?
No, that's not what I mean...\nIt's just that making another Velcaroy in town\nwould draw too much attention...
Some evil organization could be watching us from\nanywhere...\nLefina, don't forget you're being targeted...
Y-you're right.\nOkay then, can you two go ahead and find us a\nplace first?
We'll join you after prepping the ingredients for\nVelcaroy.
